exposure: antenatal corticosteroids for fetal lung maturity
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit length of stay
cohort: 478 women delivering singleton neonates between 23 and 32 weeks' gestation at a large academic center between 2012 and 2016
finding: Maternal neuraxial analgesia use was independently associated with decreased odds of necrotizing enterocolitis and grade III/IV intraventricular hemorrhage in very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Women who used neuraxial analgesia were more likely to have delivered by cesarean delivery.
